title: UI launches national search for chief financial officer
summary_en: The University of Iowa has begun a national search for its next chief financial officer, who will serve as the university's senior financial strategist and report directly to the president. The search follows last month’s announcement by current vice president and CFO Terry Johnson that he will retire in April after 33 years at the university. Read more about the search committee and the elevated
title_cn: UI launches national search for chief financial officer

title: Sandra Daack-Hirsch named associate provost for faculty
summary_en: Sandra Daack-Hirsch, professor and Dr. Rita and David Frantz Executive Associate Dean in the UI College of Nursing, has been named associate provost for faculty in the Office of the Provost. Daack-Hirsch began serving in the role part time on Sept. 1 and will transition to full time later in the academic year.
title_cn: Sandra Daack-Hirsch named associate provost for faculty

title: New AI Discovery Initiative to help you explore, build skills with AI
summary_en: The University of Iowa is launching a new effort to spark the next chapter of AI integration for its employees. The AI Discovery Initiative will expand access to AI tools, professional development, and collaborative learning to help you build skills and confidence with AI.
title_cn: New AI Discovery Initiative to help you explore, build skills with AI

title: Why you receive research recruitment emails and how to opt out
summary_en: The research recruitment emails you receive serve an important purpose. Finding participants for more than 4,000 active research projects is critical to the university’s mission. But if the messages are becoming too much, learn how you can adjust your email preferences to opt out.

title: See how our newest Hawkeyes kicked off the fall 2026 semester
summary_en: From Kickoff at Kinnick’s silent disco to yard games at Hubbard Park, the first week of classes was filled with excitement. As students settled in, they also looked ahead to opportunities such as research and study abroad. Watch this video recap of the UI welcoming new and returning students to campus for fall 2026.

title: Students help tell the Hawkeye story in new game-day commercial
summary_en: Students take center stage in the UI’s new national TV spot, which will air during Hawkeye sporting events this year. Meet the Hawkeyes featured in the commercial and hear about what makes the Iowa experience so valuable. Go Hawks!

title: 2026 Distinguished Alumni Award recipients include Marilynne Robinson
summary_en: From Pulitzer Prize winners to Olympic Games advisors, meet the six Distinguished Alumni Award honorees who exemplify the Hawkeye tradition of excellence. The UI’s highest alumni honor this year includes decorated and influential writer Marilynne Robinson.
